releaseNotes:
✨ Highlights in Voltrex Light 1.0.1:
• Added dedicated Refresh button and F5 hotkey support in Storage Analysis toolbar.
• Fixed real-time scanning indications across titlebar, sidebar, and workspace.
• Resolved concurrent scan race conditions and background UI thread dispatching.
• Enhanced stability during rapid drive and folder re-analysis.
• Continued 100% private, local file processing with zero telemetry.
